messages:
Maria: quick sync — we just finished a messy SEV with Voltrix (hardware partner) + their SI. want to standardize the handoff so Partner PMs don't have to babysit ops. ideas?
Ajay: +1. main pain: unclear channel ownership and duplicate bridges. Partners DM product, eng, and oncall separately.
Henry: recommend a pattern: 1) shared channel created with naming convention, 2) short warroom with reps from each org, 3) single bridge URL pinned.
Tia: naming suggestion: #partner-<vendor>-sev-<yyyyMmdd> or for ongoing incidents #partner-<vendor>-active. keeps discovery simple. :thumbsup:
Lina: can we also require a one-line triage template in the channel header so partners fill: impact, reproduction, recent deploys, customer id? saves back-and-forth.
Ajay: love the template. propose we add a lightweight runbook checklist in the channel topic with 6 steps: declare severity, create bridge, tag oncall, collect logs, triage owner, next-step plan.
Maria: +1. what about the bridge? we have customers spamming both Zoom links and PagerDuty. I'd prefer we standardize on our warroom + Zoom for execs. use /call from #eng-oncall to create persistent warroom link.
Henry: technical note: our /call bot supports one-click recording and pins the trace link. we should make that mandatory for cross-org SEVs. incident-bot: warroom created -> https://warroom.redwood/2468123456 (auto).
Tia: suggestion for escalation path: partner reports -> partnerships channel triage -> create shared channel -> tag redwood-oncall & partner-oncall -> 30-min warroom check-in -> escalate to exec bridge if SLA breach.
Ajay: add role matrix to the shared channel pinned message: Partner PM, Partner SE, Redwood SE, Redwood Oncall, Redwood Partnerships lead. include backup rotation contact numbers.
Maria: Ops request: we need a one-page handoff checklist to give to major partners before launch. Lina, can you draft a lean checklist we can share in partner onboarding?
Lina: can do. will draft and post in #partnerships-docs and share link here by EOD tomorrow.
Henry: also recommend automated routing rules in PagerDuty: if incident tagged partner:<vendor> then notify partnerships schedule + eng-oncall schedule + partner email alias. reduces manual tagging.
Tia: for marketplace launches (cloud marketplace partners) we should add a pre-warm step: a dry-run warroom 48h before launch to validate contact paths and run the checklist.
Ajay: agree. also add a short post-incident retro template for joint root-cause + action items in the channel, set owner, and SLA to close actions within 7 days.
Maria: next steps: Lina drafts checklist and triage template, Henry will scope PD routing rules, Ajay will draft channel topic template, Tia will schedule a pilot dry-run with Voltrix next week. I'll coordinate with Partner PM. :smile:
Lina: noted. I'll post draft link when ready.
incident-bot: reminder: when creating a partner warroom include the tag `partner-warroom` to auto-apply playbook.
Ajay: can someone add a short sample message we can paste when creating the shared channel? saves time.
Tia: sample paste: "Hello — Voltrix SEV: impact X, customer Y, reproduction steps Z. Redwood oncall: @redwood-oncall. Bridge: <link>. Next steps: triage owner assigned."
Maria: perfect. I'll add that to the onboarding doc. thanks everyone. :rocket:
Henry: we should run this as a 2-week pilot with 2 partners (Voltrix, CloudAxis) and collect feedback.
Lina: +1. will include a quick feedback checkbox in the post-incident template.
Maria: closing loop — will post follow-up plan + calendar invite for pilot kickoff in #partnerships later today.
